description_en: Provides an example of querying the details of remediation setting crr-f381cf0c1c2f004e****
description_zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询修正设置crr-f381cf0c1c2f004e****的详情
kebab_example: aliyun config describe-remediation --config-rule-id cr-3184626622af0030000 --remediation-id crr-f381cf0c1c2f004e0000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRemediation

parameters.help_en: The rule ID. You must specify at least one of ConfigRuleId and RemediationId to identify an existing remediation setting
parameters.help_zh: 规则 ID。ConfigRuleId 与 RemediationId 至少提供一个能定位到已存在修正设置的有效标识符
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The remediation setting ID. You can call [ListRemediations](~~ListRemediations~~) to obtain the ID. If you have not created a remediation setting, call [ListConfigRules](~~ListConfigRules~~) to obtain rules, call [ListRemediationTemplates](~~ListRemediationTemplates~~) with the ManagedRuleIdentifier filter to obtain compatible templates, call [CreateRemediation](~~CreateRemediation~~) to create a remediation setting, and then call [DescribeRemediation](~~DescribeRemediation~~) to query the setting. You must specify at least one of ConfigRuleId and RemediationId
parameters.help_zh: 修正设置 ID，可通过 ListRemediations 获取。若尚未创建修正设置，推荐依次调用 ListConfigRules 获取规则、ListRemediationTemplates（按 ManagedRuleIdentifier 过滤）获取兼容模板、CreateRemediation 创建修正设置，再调用 DescribeRemediation 查询。ConfigRuleId 与 RemediationId 至少提供一个有效标识符
parameters.name: remediation_id

Remediation.description_en: The details of the remediation setting

InvokeType.description_en:
The remediation execution method. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: Not executed.

AUTO_EXECUTION: Automatically executed.

MANUAL_EXECUTION: Manually executed.

NOT_CONFIG: Settings not configured
InvokeType.description_zh:
修正执行方式。取值：

NON_EXECUTION：不执行。

AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。

MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。

NOT_CONFIG：未设置

LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_en: The record ID of the last successful remediation execute
LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的记录ID

LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the remediation was last successfully executed. Unit: milliseconds
LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的时间戳。单位：毫秒

LastSuccessfulInvocationType.description_en:
The method of the last successful remediation execution. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: Not executed.

AUTO_EXECUTION: Automatically executed.

MANUAL_EXECUTION: Manually executed.

NOT_CONFIG: Not configured
LastSuccessfulInvocationType.description_zh:
修正最近一次执行成功的方式。取值：

NON_EXECUTION：不执行。

AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。

MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。

NOT_CONFIG：未设置

RemediationOriginParams.description_en: The converted format of the remediation setting parameters. This parameter is used only to convert the parameters of OOS templates
RemediationOriginParams.description_zh: 修正设置参数的转换格式。仅用于转换OOS模板的参数

RemediationSourceType.description_en:
The source of the template used for remediation. Valid values:

ALIYUN: China site template.

CUSTOM: Custom template.

NONE: None
RemediationSourceType.description_zh:
执行修正的模板来源。取值：

ALIYUN：官网模板。

CUSTOM：自定义模板。

NONE：无

RemediationType.description_en:
The remediation type. Valid values:

OOS: CloudOps Orchestration Service (official remediation).

FC: Function Compute (custom remediation)
RemediationType.description_zh:
修正类型。取值：

OOS：运维编排（官方修正）。

FC：函数计算（自定义修正）
